descriptions: READY matching reference, one two-handed pickaxe across waist.
HORIZONTAL PICK SWEEP: both hands spaced on single straight shaft, head sweeps across front at waist/chest height, pelvis and shoulders rotate together, front boot planted.
PICK HOOK: two hands on shaft push pick head FORWARD at chest height then slightly hook INWARD; low planted lunge, not an overhead strike or a second tool.
CHARGE CONTACT: torso leans forward through hips with one front knee bent; both hands brace ONE pick across front low chest like a bar, grounded leading boot, no airborne leap.
READY: LEFT strapped rectangular shield and RIGHT short hammer.
HAMMER DOWN CONTACT: RIGHT hammer has descended from right shoulder down toward ground outside RIGHT foot; LEFT shield stays raised beside LEFT ribs, crouch through knees, no extra arm.
HAMMER HORIZONTAL SWEEP: RIGHT hammer extends horizontally across front from RIGHT toward LEFT at lower chest height, LEFT forearm shield held safely left, grounded hip turn, no weapon swap.

STONE WALL COMMAND: LEFT forearm pushes strapped shield outward/up on LEFT silhouette; RIGHT hand keeps hammer low outside RIGHT thigh. Both knees planted and slight stern lean. Not an open third palm.
READY: RIGHT wrench, LEFT forearm launcher and empty LEFT fingers.
OVERHEAD LOAD: RIGHT hand lifts the ONE iron wrench over RIGHT shoulder, LEFT launcher hand low and safely outside LEFT ribs, two elbows connected, no idle extra wrench at hip.
WRENCH HORIZONTAL CONTACT: RIGHT wrench sweeps across front at waist height with elbow partly bent and grip secure; LEFT launcher forearm held out of strike path, coherent grounded hip turn.
WRENCH GROUND CONTACT: RIGHT wrench brought DOWN beside RIGHT front boot, knees bend and torso hinges at hips, LEFT launcher arm stays near left ribs. Tool in hand, not thrown.
READY: RIGHT one sword, LEFT empty.
SWORD THRUST: RIGHT sword points straight FORWARD at chest height, elbow extends and front boot planted, LEFT empty palm counterbalances; sword grip in fingers, no uppercut.

REVERSE HORIZONTAL CUT: RIGHT sword travels from LEFT side of torso to RIGHT outside hip at waist height, hips/shoulders rotate coherently, blade level and one connected RIGHT wrist, LEFT palm empty aside.

RETURNING SWORD RELEASE: RIGHT arm opens forward with EMPTY right fingers just after releasing sword; LEFT empty palm stays low at LEFT waist. NO sword left at hip, NO floating projectile drawn, no duplicate hand. Game supplies flying sword.
READY: anatomical RIGHT three leaf needles, LEFT one short dagger.

NEEDLE RELEASE: RIGHT arm extends forward with fingers OPEN EMPTY after releasing three needles; LEFT hand still firmly holds dagger low outside LEFT hip. No loose projectile drawn, never release LEFT dagger here.
DAGGER FIRST DOWN CUT: LEFT hand grips dagger and cuts from LEFT shoulder DOWN-FORWARD, LEFT wrist attached, torso turns coherently. RIGHT hand retains three leaf needles safely near RIGHT ribs.

DAGGER REVERSE HORIZONTAL CUT: LEFT dagger travels horizontally across front from RIGHT toward LEFT outside LEFT hip; RIGHT three needles retained near right ribs; TWO arms only, hips turn with shoulders.
DAGGER CHARGE: front boot planted low forward lunge, LEFT dagger held FORWARD at waist height in LEFT fingers; RIGHT needles stay tucked safely at right ribs, no new blade or extra palm.
READY: ONE straight plain bamboo staff, both hands spaced grips, no blade and gourds at LEFT hip.
STAFF STRAIGHT THRUST: two hands push ONE continuous straight bamboo staff FORWARD chest height, leading boot planted and rear elbow bent, no blade/two handles.
STAFF REVERSE HORIZONTAL STRIKE: both hands grip ONE staff horizontally across front from other side, hips and shoulders rotate together; keep both smooth staff ends and at least one planted foot.
STAFF CHARGE: low forward torso lean and leading knee bent, ONE staff held across chest as two-handed brace, front boot planted. No jump, no saber or spear tip.
READY: RIGHT one sword, LEFT empty.
SWORD STRAIGHT THRUST: RIGHT wrist extends one sword FORWARD at chest height, leading boot grounded, LEFT empty counterbalance, no upward blade arc.
REVERSE HORIZONTAL CUT: RIGHT sword cuts across front from LEFT toward RIGHT at waist/chest height with coherent hips and shoulders; LEFT empty arm safely outside LEFT silhouette.
THIRD DOWN DIAGONAL FINISH: RIGHT sword descends from RIGHT shoulder to LOW FORWARD opposite side, lowered knees and forward grounded boot; ONE blade and RIGHT wrist, LEFT empty. Not low-to-high.
READY: RIGHT ONE open bamboo-painted fan by root, LEFT empty.
FAN STRAIGHT STRIKE: RIGHT elbow extends the ROOT-GRIPPED fan FORWARD at chest height, fan plane foreshortens naturally, LEFT empty hand safely beside LEFT ribs, feet grounded.
FAN REVERSE HORIZONTAL: RIGHT fan sweeps horizontally from LEFT toward RIGHT outside RIGHT hip, RIGHT fingers always at fan root, LEFT empty arm counterbalances, coherent waist turn, no uppercut.
FAN CHARGE: front boot planted and torso leans forward slightly, RIGHT open fan held forward outside RIGHT ribs as strike; LEFT hand empty beside LEFT waist. No third hand, no fan at left hip.
